acceptance: Accept an explicit positive liminf for |C_q(T)-C_0(T)| only after a rigorous remainder bound and vanishing state error. Numerical checks support exact arithmetic; the analytic proof carries the infinite-system claim.

definitions.observable: Exactly frozen U1 W on the eight free links; C_q stationary connected autocorrelation and C_0=e^(-iEt/hbar), E=9alpha/2.
definitions.scales: T=C(hbar/alpha)epsilon^-3, epsilon=1-q, fixed C>0, eta in (0,1), a,E_star,alpha/E_star,hbar>0. Seek an explicit nonempty interval of small z=Ceta, no fitted clock.
definitions.state: Retain d_q<=sigma_q/gbar and actual stationary ground. Preserve unbounded H_0 domain and strong integral topology.
definitions.support: At most 10 links per complete factor, at most 4 faces per link, at most 4 factors per face. Include all connected ordered words, repeated faces and bulk factors.

model: M1/M2/N1 canonical summable full-link SU(2) model on the nonnegative cubic orthant; not T finite graph
next_loop: After six reviewed S/T/U loops, select V/W roadmap goals and stop; do not freeze or execute V1.
target: Prove or refute an actual full-system endpoint autocorrelation difference for the exact U1 observable using a connected-word remainder. A failed certificate alone is limited, not nonconvergence.
